title: Geschäftsbericht 2025
summary: The partial document is a business report for Rhein Mühlenwerke GmbH for the year 2025. It covers several key areas including an overview of the conglomerate, mill performance and products, raw material acquisition, quality assurance, logistics, and energy and climate strategies.

nodes.title: Konzernüberblick
nodes.summary: The partial document covers the overview of Rhein Mühlenwerke GmbH, a family foundation established in 1888. It operates three mill sites along the Rhine river and employs 180 people. The main headquarters and administration, as well as the main mill, are located in Worms. The other two sites in Karlsruhe and Mainz function solely as production mills.

nodes.title: Mahlleistung und Produkte
nodes.summary: The partial document covers the mill performance and products in 2025, including the production quantities by location and product group, as well as existing silo capacity. The document notes that Weizenmehl Type 550 is the most produced product. It also mentions the total production was 128,000 tons, with a shift of 4,000 tons of wheat flour to rye whole grain due to the expansion of the whole grain section. The document includes a table detailing the production quantities for each location and product.

nodes.title: Rohstoffbeschaffung
nodes.summary: The document covers the procurement of raw materials, specifically focusing on the acquisition of grains. It mentions that approximately 87% of the grains come from about 210 contractually bound local farmers. It also notes the protein content of the purchased wheat in 2025 and details the storage capacity and quality control procedures for the grains.

nodes.title: Qualität
nodes.summary: The partial document covers the quality assurance efforts and certifications of a manufacturing facility. Key points include the number of back inspections conducted in 2025, the commission rate, and certification status. The document also mentions a weekly evaluation of bread testing by the team.

nodes.title: Logistik
nodes.summary: The partial document covers the modes of transportation used for delivery, including trucks (42%), trains (33%), and barges (25%). It also mentions the company's fleet of 18 silo trucks. Additionally, it notes the renewal of the railway connection in Worms in 2024, which now operates three full trains per week. The average distance to the customer is 96 kilometers.

nodes.title: Energie und Klima
nodes.summary: The partial document covers energy and climate topics, including electricity consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. In 2025, the electricity consumption was 6.2 gigawatt-hours, with 1.9 gigawatt-hours contributed by the main mill's block heating power station. The document also mentions a goal to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to 60 kilograms of CO2 equivalent per ton of flour by 2030, achieved through power generated from the facility itself.
